This vignette collects short, self-contained recipes for common
`neuroarchive` workflows. Each recipe creates its own data and temp
files so you can run any section independently.

```{r}
library(neuroarchive)
library(neuroim2)
```

```{r helpers, include = FALSE}
make_demo_bundle <- function(dims = c(4L, 4L, 4L), n_time = 2L, seed = 1L) {
  sp <- neuroim2::NeuroSpace(as.integer(dims), spacing = c(2, 2, 2))
  mask <- neuroim2::LogicalNeuroVol(array(TRUE, dim = dims), sp)
  mask_vol <- neuroim2::NeuroVol(as.integer(as.array(mask)), sp)
  sim <- neuroim2::simulate_fmri(mask_vol, n_time = as.integer(n_time), seed = as.integer(seed))
  vec <- methods::as(sim, "DenseNeuroVec")
  list(vec = vec, mask = mask, space = sp)
}
```

## Quantization and Lazy Reading

Write data with quantization and read a temporal subset lazily (without
loading the entire file into memory).

```{r quant_lazy}
bundle <- make_demo_bundle(n_time = 2L, seed = 11L)
x <- bundle$vec
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")

write_lna(x, tmp, transforms = "quant")

# Open lazily and read a single timepoint
r <- read_lna(tmp, lazy = TRUE)
r$subset(time_idx = 1)
subset_data <- r$data()
r$close()

cat(sprintf("Full data: %s\n", paste(dim(as.array(x)), collapse = " x ")))
cat(sprintf("Subset shape: %s\n", paste(dim(subset_data), collapse = " x ")))
```

## PCA Compression Pipeline

Combine PCA basis decomposition with quantization for higher compression.

```{r pca_pipeline}
set.seed(1)
bundle <- make_demo_bundle(n_time = 10L, seed = 12L)
x <- bundle$vec
x_arr <- as.array(x)
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")

write_lna(x, tmp,
          transforms = c("basis", "embed", "quant"),
          transform_params = list(basis = list(k = 5)))

handle <- read_lna(tmp)
recon <- handle$stash$input

cat(sprintf("Original range: [%.2f, %.2f]\n", min(x_arr), max(x_arr)))
cat(sprintf("Correlation: %.4f\n",
            cor(as.vector(x_arr), as.vector(recon))))
```

## ROI and Time Slicing

Use a binary mask to read only voxels in a region of interest,
combined with time indexing.

```{r roi_slicing}
set.seed(2)
bundle <- make_demo_bundle(n_time = 6L, seed = 13L)
x <- bundle$vec
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")

write_lna(x, tmp,
          transforms = "quant",
          transform_params = list(quant = list(bits = 8)))

r <- read_lna(tmp, lazy = TRUE)

# Create a binary ROI mask (keep ~half the voxels)
roi_arr <- array(runif(prod(dim(bundle$mask))) > 0.5, dim = dim(bundle$mask))
roi <- neuroim2::LogicalNeuroVol(roi_arr, bundle$space)
r$subset(roi_mask = roi, time_idx = 1:3)
roi_data <- r$data()
r$close()

cat(sprintf("Voxels in ROI: %d\n", sum(roi_arr)))
cat(sprintf("ROI subset shape: %s\n",
            paste(dim(roi_data), collapse = " x ")))
```

## Temporal Transform (DCT)

Project time series onto a DCT basis for temporal compression.

```{r temporal_dct}
set.seed(3)
bundle <- make_demo_bundle(n_time = 20L, seed = 14L)
x <- bundle$vec
x_arr <- as.array(x)
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")

write_lna(x, tmp,
          transforms = c("temporal", "quant"),
          transform_params = list(
            temporal = list(kind = "dct", n_basis = 10),
            quant = list(bits = 8)
          ))

handle <- read_lna(tmp)
recon <- handle$stash$input

cat(sprintf("Correlation: %.4f\n",
            cor(as.vector(x_arr), as.vector(recon))))
cat(sprintf("File size: %.1f KB\n",
            file.info(tmp)$size / 1024))
```

## Delta Transform (Lossless)

Delta encoding computes first-order differences along the time axis.
It is lossless and often helps subsequent quantization.

```{r delta_transform}
set.seed(4)
bundle <- make_demo_bundle(n_time = 8L, seed = 15L)
x <- bundle$vec
x_arr <- as.array(x)
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")

write_lna(x, tmp, transforms = "delta")

handle <- read_lna(tmp)
recon <- handle$stash$input

cat(sprintf("Max reconstruction error: %e\n",
            max(abs(as.vector(x_arr) - as.vector(recon)))))
```

## Haar Octave Wavelet

The `spat.haar_octwave` transform performs a 3D Haar wavelet analysis
using Morton-curve ordering. Small detail coefficients can be
thresholded for lossy spatial compression.

```{r haar_octwave}
set.seed(5)
bundle <- make_demo_bundle(n_time = 4L, seed = 16L)
x <- bundle$vec
mask <- bundle$mask
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")

roundtrip_internal_haar <- function(x, file, ...) {
  old_engine <- lna_options("engine.math")[[1]]
  on.exit(lna_options(engine.math = old_engine), add = TRUE)
  lna_options(engine.math = "internal")
  write_lna(x, file, ...)
  read_lna(file)
}
handle <- roundtrip_internal_haar(
  x, tmp,
  mask = mask,
  transforms = "spat.haar_octwave",
  transform_params = list(spat.haar_octwave = list(levels = 2))
)
recon <- handle$stash$input

# Spatial transforms return a time-by-voxel matrix
cat(sprintf("Output shape: %s\n", paste(dim(recon), collapse = " x ")))
cat(sprintf("File size: %.1f KB\n", file.info(tmp)$size / 1024))
```

## Validate an LNA File

`validate_lna()` checks file structure, schema conformance, and
SHA-256 checksums.

```{r validate}
set.seed(6)
bundle <- make_demo_bundle(n_time = 2L, seed = 17L)
x <- bundle$vec
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")

write_lna(x, tmp, transforms = "quant")

# Returns TRUE when the file is sound
is_valid <- validate_lna(tmp)
cat(sprintf("Valid: %s\n", is_valid))
```

## Multi-Step Pipeline

Chain three transforms for aggressive compression: PCA reduces
dimensions, then temporal DCT compresses in time, and finally 8-bit
quantization minimizes storage.

```{r multistep}
set.seed(7)
bundle <- make_demo_bundle(dims = c(6L, 6L, 6L), n_time = 30L, seed = 18L)
x <- bundle$vec
x_arr <- as.array(x)
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")

write_lna(x, tmp,
          transforms = c("basis", "embed", "temporal", "quant"),
          transform_params = list(
            basis = list(k = 15),
            temporal = list(kind = "dct", n_basis = 20),
            quant = list(bits = 8)
          ))

handle <- read_lna(tmp)
recon <- handle$stash$input

input_kb <- prod(dim(x_arr)) * 4 / 1024
output_kb <- file.info(tmp)$size / 1024
cat(sprintf("Input: %.1f KB -> Output: %.1f KB (%.1fx)\n",
            input_kb, output_kb, input_kb / output_kb))
cat(sprintf("Correlation: %.4f\n",
            cor(as.vector(x_arr), as.vector(recon))))
```

## Recipe Summary

The table below compares file sizes across the recipes run in this
vignette.

```{r summary_table, echo = FALSE}
recipes <- c("Quant + Lazy", "PCA Pipeline", "ROI Slicing",
             "Temporal DCT", "Delta", "Haar Octwave", "Validate",
             "Multi-Step")

# Collect temp file paths in creation order
tmp_paths <- mget(ls(pattern = "^tmp"), envir = environment())
tmp_paths <- Filter(function(v) is.character(v) && length(v) == 1 && file.exists(v), tmp_paths)
sizes_kb <- vapply(tmp_paths, function(f) file.info(f)$size / 1024, numeric(1))

# Trim to match recipe names (one temp file per recipe)
n <- min(length(recipes), length(sizes_kb))
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Recipe = recipes[seq_len(n)],
  `Size (KB)` = round(sizes_kb[seq_len(n)], 1),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(summary_df, align = c("l", "r"))
```

```{r summary_barplot, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3.5, fig.cap = "File sizes by recipe."}
if (nrow(summary_df) > 0) {
  old_par <- par(mar = c(5, 8, 2, 1))
  barplot(summary_df[["Size (KB)"]],
          names.arg = summary_df$Recipe,
          horiz = TRUE, las = 1, cex.names = 0.7,
          xlab = "File size (KB)",
          col = "steelblue", border = NA)
  par(old_par)
}
```

```{r cleanup, include = FALSE}
# Clean up all temp files created in this vignette
tmp_files <- ls(pattern = "^tmp")
for (f in tmp_files) {
  val <- get(f)
  if (is.character(val) && file.exists(val)) unlink(val)
}
```
